Air India crash victims' families demand black box data

Families of victims from an Air India plane crash have demanded the public release of the black box data and cockpit voice recordings. The specific crash details are not provided, but the families' requests highlight a desire for transparency following the incident. This action underscores the emotional and informational needs of those affected by aviation tragedies.
